Mr. C.B. was defeated in the Nihon Derby. 
Yet, seeing her run, the crowd was abuzz 
with excitement, believing she truly is an 
extraordinary talent capable of surpassing 
even "the Myth."

Mr. C.B. explains that while losing 
stings, she enjoyed the race more than 
anything else.

She is thrilled to learn that the 
pre-debut Symboli Rudolf is already 
drawing attention, imagining how much she 
will transform over the course of a year.

Meanwhile, the defeated Katsuragi Ace was 
filled with regret, frustrated that she 
had merely served as a foil.

Mr. C.B.'s next goal is the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
